A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''commander''' was in charge of a [[matalok]] near the ''[[Baanu Rass]]'' [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. When the commandeered ''[[Exquisite Death]]'' approached the worldship, the commander ordered the crew, consisting of a [[Myrkr strike team|Jedi team]], to surrender. However, the Jedi fired a [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at the matalok, destroying it and killing the commander.
